decisions.reason: The devore line sits squarely within the firm's design and decoration expertise and its several variants support reorder continuity, but fashion-driven decorative fabrics turn over with collection cycles, so there is a moderate risk of replacement.

This transparent burnout line uses the firm's established know-how and customer feedback channels, which lets management adjust it rather than drop it, though trend dependence raises the risk of collection rotation.
This single burnout article overlaps with lines A and B and is exposed to trend cycles, but it is cheap to keep in a stocked range close to the core business.
The velour-like upholstery fabric builds on the firm's upholstery competence and serves steady, less fashion-sensitive demand, so the firm can keep refining it.
The flame-retardant plain fabric meets durable demand from contract and retail buyers, uses technical knowledge the firm already holds, and fits its availability promise.
The satin polyester lining is a basic staple that complements the made-to-measure sewing service and builds directly on existing know-how and warehouse logistics.
